description: Implement and verify restoration of a166700-neuron organism, physical body, pending sensory input, static odor field and effective operator from its own100ms saved state; require exact initial state before a300ms continuation. External checkpoint diagnostics previously omitted effective operator arrays.

Review an external C++ step-proposal candidate: fourteenCPU CUDA-mock tests and real CUDA-header compilation passed, but no GPU organism trial exists. Determine the limits of these claims and a bounded future real-data comparison; do not call compilation a measured speedup.

Derive an error/influence bound for sparse spatial updates of graded release and transmission in a recurrent whole-brain system. Neurons without new spikes may still send continuously changing synaptic output; real-state density will be measured separately.

Design the first source-approach pilot after functional orientation qualifies. Existing body uses an explicit synthetic contact-roller decoder capped at5degrees/s and0.5mm/s. Distinguish source approach from tonic forward movement using matched odor/no-odor and decoupled sensory controls; do not retune gain after seeing direction.
